settings.question: How much does a tire change cost in Calgary?
settings.answer: A seasonal swap on rims is $15 a tire for cars and SUVs ($60 for four) and $20 a tire for trucks ($80 for four). Mounting and balancing tires that are not on rims is $30 a tire for cars and SUVs ($120 for four, the same when you buy the tires from us), $35 for trucks or SUVs on 265 mm+ tires, $40 for large trucks and $45 for duallies. Prices are before 5% GST, and an ARMA recycling fee applies per tire we dispose of. You'll see the exact price when you book online.

settings.question: Do you do the swap back in spring too?
settings.answer: Yes — same per-tire price, same 30 minutes, and the calendar is far easier than it is in October. The swap back is usually April, once overnight lows stop dropping below 7°C. For the full timing question — when to put winter tires on and when to take them off — see winter and snow tires in Calgary, which covers both ends of the season.

settings.question: What's the difference between a changeover and tire installation?
settings.answer: A changeover assumes your winter and summer tires each sit on their own set of rims — we just swap which set is on the vehicle. Tire installation is for loose tires that aren't on rims yet: we mount them, balance them, and set up the wheels from scratch — see tire installation in Calgary for that pricing. If you're not sure which one you need, give us a call and describe what you've got.

settings.question: How long does a seasonal tire swap take?
settings.answer: A standard car or SUV changeover takes about 30 minutes. Trucks and installations take a little longer. Book a time slot online and there's no waiting around — drop the vehicle, we swap the wheels, torque everything to spec, and you're back on the road.

settings.question: Do you store my off-season tires?
settings.answer: No — Prince Tires doesn't offer tire storage, so your off-season set goes home with you. Store them somewhere cool, dry and out of direct sunlight — a garage corner or basement works well. If they're on rims, stack them flat or hang them; loose tires are best kept standing upright.

settings.question: Can you swap tires I bought somewhere else?
settings.answer: Yes. It doesn't matter where your tires or rims came from — another shop, a dealership, or online. As long as your seasonal tires are mounted on rims that fit your vehicle, we'll change them over at the same per-tire price, with no outside-purchase surcharge.

settings.heading: What's included
settings.body:
• Swap: your mounted wheels come off, the other set goes on, and every lug nut is torqued to spec. Re-torque after 50 to 100 km.
  • Install: old tires off the rims, new tires mounted and balanced, wheels torqued to spec.
  • We don't sell used tires, do wheel alignments or store tires. Your off-season set goes home with you.

settings.question: Which Prince Tires shop should I go to?
settings.answer: Either one. SW is at 111 42 Ave SW, (403) 452-4283. NE is at 3928 Edmonton Trail NE, (825) 395-4024. Both do seasonal swaps and installations. Road Force balancing is at the NE shop only.

settings.heading: Tire Change Calgary — Seasonal Swaps & Installs
settings.subheading: Winter or spring, Prince Tires changes your tires at two Calgary shops: 111 42 Ave SW and 3928 Edmonton Trail NE. A seasonal swap on your own rims is $15 a tire ($60 for four). Mounting and balancing tires not on rims starts at $30 a tire ($120 for four). Every wheel is torqued to spec. Prices are before GST.
settings.pricing_intro: These are two different jobs. A seasonal swap is for tires already mounted on their own rims: we move the right set onto your vehicle and torque every wheel to spec. An installation is for tires not on rims: we mount them, balance them and fit them. Prices are per tire, before 5% GST. An ARMA recycling fee applies per tire when we dispose of old tires.

settings.lead: On their own rims — this is a changeover
settings.text: Four mounted wheels come off, four go on, every nut torqued to spec. Nothing is dismounted, so nothing needs rebalancing. $15 a tire for cars and SUVs ($60 for four), $20 for trucks, about 30 minutes.

settings.lead: Sharing one set of rims — that is an installation
settings.text: Each tire has to be dismounted from the rim and the other one mounted and balanced in its place. More labour, and it works the tire beads twice a year. That is the installation rate.

settings.lead: A second set of rims usually pays for itself
settings.text: Steel rims are inexpensive and shrug off road salt. After the first winter, every changeover is the cheaper job instead of the dearer one.

settings.lead: Either way the wheels get torqued, not gunned
settings.text: And the same re-torque check at 50 to 100 km applies.

settings.heading: Changeover or installation? They are different jobs
settings.intro: The price difference comes down to one question: are your seasonal tires already on their own rims?
settings.outro:
Not sure which you have? Look at your off-season tires. If they are sitting on wheels, it is a changeover.

If a set that rode fine last season shakes at highway speed once it goes back on, give it 20 minutes or more of highway driving first; most storage flat spots warm out. If it doesn't settle, a standard balance is the first step and road force balancing at Edmonton Trail NE is the next.

settings.lead: The rush is mid-October to mid-November
settings.text: Appointments tighten first, then walk-in waits get long. The work does not get slower; the queue gets longer.

settings.lead: The first snowfall is the worst day to call
settings.text: Demand spikes the same morning. Anyone who booked in advance is already scheduled.
Walk-ins are welcome and we fit them around booked work, but a slot is the difference between dropping the car and waiting.
The swap back runs roughly April, once overnight lows stop dipping under 7°C. Less pressure on the calendar, and leaving winter tires on into summer wears them quickly.

settings.heading: Booking around the October rush
settings.intro: Every tire shop in Calgary sees the same three weeks. Temperatures drop under 7°C, the first snow is forecast, and the whole city books at once.
settings.outro: Book a seasonal swap or call SW (403) 452-4283 or NE (825) 395-4024. For which tires to run and when to fit them, see winter and snow tires in Calgary.
